entities.name: Abraham
entities.summary: Patriarch; the covenant with God begins with him.

entities.name: Bathsheba
entities.summary: Wife of Uriah, then of David; mother of Solomon.

entities.name: David
entities.summary: King of Israel; associated with many Psalms.

entities.name: Goliath
entities.summary: Philistine champion from Gath, defeated by David.

entities.name: Jesus
entities.summary: Central figure of the New Testament.

entities.name: John
entities.summary: Disciple of Jesus; traditionally linked to the Gospel of John.

entities.name: Moses
entities.summary: Led Israel out of Egypt; received the Law.

entities.name: Paul
entities.summary: Apostle; author of many New Testament letters.

entities.name: Peter
entities.summary: Disciple of Jesus; leader among the apostles.

entities.name: Samuel
entities.summary: Prophet and judge; anointed Saul and David.

entities.name: Solomon
entities.summary: King of Israel; built the first temple.
